summary: Northpointe Bancshares (NYSE: NPB), holding company for Northpointe Bank, filed an 8-K on October 6, 2026, disclosing that its Board declared a quarterly cash dividend increase to $0.03 per common share, a 20% rise from the prior $0.025. The dividend is payable November 4, 2026, to holders of record October 15, 2026. No advisor or board recommendation beyond declaration was cited. This maps to a routine capital-return action; watch for sustainability of the payout given the bank's earnings and any signaling about capital adequacy.
